dict.string: Vibeking needs microphone access to transcribe your voice into text.
Vibeking needs Input Monitoring access to detect the global hotkey (Right Control) while you work in other apps.
Vibeking uses system events to paste transcribed text into the focused application.
Vibeking uses on-device OCR to read the words on your screen so it can spell proper nouns correctly. Screen content never leaves your Mac.
